# ZROtext

> Public documentation and API contract for the Android SMS gateway, in canonical source form.

This index is generated from a fixed public-document allowlist. Follow each
document's availability, authorization and verification limits. Simulator
examples send no real SMS. An index or published artifact does not establish
physical-device, carrier or provider acceptance.

## Current status

ZROtext is in active development. The repository includes a Rust server, PostgreSQL migrations, a delivery simulator, and an Android app. The local stack is for development. Some phone and billing flows are limited to controlled tests; a hosted SMS service is not available. See the [roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/ROADMAP.md) for planned product work.

## Documentation

- [Project overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/README.md): What ZROtext is, its development status and how to run the local stack.
- [Agent texting quickstart (simulator)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/AGENT-QUICKSTART.md): Local walkthrough of the agent send flow against the simulator; sends no real SMS.
- [Send-first-message examples (restricted)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/SEND-FIRST-MESSAGE.md): Synthetic-alpha submit/status and webhook examples tested with local stubs and vectors; no general send route.
- [Public HTTP API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/API-REFERENCE.md): Generated current-route and planned-operation reference; outbound examples use the restricted synthetic-alpha plane.
- [Guarded agent send tools (simulator)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/agent-send-guardrails.md): Experimental local MCP guardrails with owner approval, idempotency and limits; simulator only, sends no real SMS.
- [Local agent setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/agent-local-setup.md): Setting up a local development stack for agent testing.
- [Local MCP tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/mcp-local-tools.md): Local Model Context Protocol tools for the development stack.
- [Agent recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/agent-recipes.md): Worked examples for agents using the local tools.
- [Architecture and delivery outcomes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): How the server, PostgreSQL store, WebSocket device stream and Android app fit together.
- [Delivery state model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/DELIVERY-STATES.md): Message delivery states and which evidence moves a message between them.
- [Current delivery guarantees and their limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/GUARANTEES.md): Implemented delivery, ambiguous-retry, idempotency and writer-fencing controls, with current availability and verification limits.
- [Self-hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/SELF-HOSTING.md): Running the Compose stack on your own infrastructure; development use, no hosted service.
- [SMS consent and compliance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/SMS-COMPLIANCE.md): Consent, opt-out and carrier-rule responsibilities for senders.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Stage of each capability; stages show progress, not availability or release dates.
- [Public HTTP API contract (OpenAPI)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/protocol/v1/openapi/public-v1.json): Machine-readable contract for the public routes as the server implements them; planned routes are labeled.
- [Protocol v1 overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/protocol/v1/README.md): Index of protocol v1 schemas, vectors and contract documents.
- [Sealed API contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/protocol/v1/sealed-api-v1.md): Sealed-content API contract.
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a vulnerability privately.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pboachie/zrotext/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution rules, DCO sign-off and the checks CI runs.

## Maintaining this index

Run `python scripts/generate_llms.py` to regenerate, or add `--check`
to verify the checked-in index. The linked Markdown files remain the
canonical documentation; this index adds no API or execution authority.
